thread:
maya: Heads up — several interviewers' 'Training Certification' completions aren't showing up in ATS for yesterday's cohort. Elena flagged 3 candidates with missing certified interviewer tags.
jordan: oh no. any errors in onboarding logs?
maya: I checked the training dashboard — completions = ✅, but the ATS webhook shows 202 accepted but no field update. sample webhook id: 0d4f8a
sam: can you paste the webhook payload/response? I'll look at the consumer service.
maya: here's the last failed sync snippet:
```
POST /webhooks/ats/update
200 OK
{"id":"0d4f8a","result":"queued"}
```
but ATS didn't get the tag.
priya: do we have any recent deploys to training-service or ats-sync? I saw a config roll earlier.
training-bot: deploy-bot: training-service v2.14.0 deployed 10m ago by ci/cd
sam: probable race/ordering with batch job. logs show our sync worker returned 200 but then exception after commit. I'll dig. Can someone DM me the affected interviewer emails?
elena: sending list now. also one of the interviewers noted their scorecard access was revoked after retrain — so this is blocking scheduled interviews today :(
jordan: @sam marking as P1 for ops. Can eng patch a hotfix? We can also run a manual backfill.
sam: I can push a fix to retry on post-acknowledgement errors. ETA 40m. Meanwhile can ops run manual backfill? jupyter job exists.
maya: yes i'll run the backfill script, but need confirmation on the safe window (no concurrent writes).
priya: note: changing sync retries requires config bump in prod-configs. Jordan, can you approve short downtime window 15m?
jordan: approve. let's do 13:30–13:45 UTC. @elena please pause interviewer assignments during that window.
elena: paused assignments. also added a calendar note for impacted interviews.
sam: pushed retry patch to staging, will promote after smoke tests pass. putting a small rollback plan in case of duplicate tags.
training-bot: incident-bot: outage created #1747777777 (Training -> ATS sync) severity: P1
maya: :thumbsup: thanks everyone. I'll post back when backfill completes.
